youtubeDescription: Explore the settings menu in Aquacellum to customize your experience. Learn how to manage backups, alerts, accessibility, and your privacy. Make the app work for you.

beats.narration: Welcome to the settings menu in Aquacellum. Here, you’ll find tools to tailor the app to your needs.

beats.onScreen: Focus on 'You' section: Experience Mode toggle and Account settings.
beats.narration: Start with Experience Mode. Switch between Casual and Pro styles, or replay onboarding anytime. Your account settings are just below.

beats.onScreen: Highlight Notifications settings with quiet hours toggle.
beats.narration: Next, manage alerts. Enable push notifications by category. Set quiet hours to avoid interruptions.

beats.onScreen: Scroll through Accessibility options: font size, high contrast, haptics.
beats.narration: Accessibility options adapt the interface to your preferences. Adjust font size, enable high contrast, or reduce motion effects.

beats.onScreen: Show 'Your Fishroom' section: Backup/Sync and active tank selector.
beats.narration: In Your Fishroom, sync and back up your tank data instantly. Choose your active tank for focused updates.

beats.onScreen: Highlight Discovery section with gated features labeled clearly.
beats.narration: Discovery tools like saved searches and watchlists unlock with experience points. Check your progress to access them.

beats.onScreen: Scroll to App section: Backup and Reset options.
beats.narration: Under App settings, export or import a JSON backup of your data. Reset the app if needed.

beats.onScreen: Focus on Privacy & Data section: GDPR tools.
beats.narration: Privacy and data controls are at the bottom. Export your data or delete your account whenever you choose.
Every setting is here to help you customize your experience. Make Aquacellum work for you.

beats.onScreen: Aquacellum logo and calm ocean visuals.
beats.narration: Explore your settings today. Your aquarium, your way.
